headline: AI Code Reviewers Fail to Spot Same Security Bug Across 4 Models
summary: A new benchmark reveals that Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.7 Flash, and DeepSeek-R1 all missed a critical one-line security vulnerability during refactoring tests.
details: A recent benchmark study tested the effectiveness of leading AI code reviewers in identifying security vulnerabilities that are not explicitly flagged for detection.
The experiment involved running ten seemingly harmless code refactoring tasks through four prominent AI models: Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.7 Flash, and DeepSeek-R1.
Shockingly, all four AI models failed to detect the exact same one-line security bug present in the code, highlighting a significant blind spot in their current capabilities.
This finding raises concerns about the reliance on AI for code security reviews, especially when dealing with subtle or non-obvious vulnerabilities that require deeper contextual understanding.
caption:
Four major AI code reviewers, including GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.7 Flash, all missed the same critical security bug.

A recent benchmark study tested the effectiveness of leading AI code reviewers in identifying security vulnerabilities that are not explicitly flagged for detection.

The experiment involved running ten seemingly harmless code refactoring tasks through four prominent AI models: Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.7 Flash, and DeepSeek-R1.

Shockingly, all four AI models failed to detect the exact same one-line security bug present in the code, highlighting a significant blind spot in their current capabilities.

This finding raises concerns about the reliance on AI for code security reviews, especially when dealing with subtle or non-obvious vulnerabilities that require deeper contextual understanding.
